name: Chirpline
summary: An eight-page messaging dashboard for SMS, WhatsApp and email with a shared inbox and campaigns
about: An eight-page dashboard for a shop that talks to its customers by SMS, WhatsApp and email. A three-pane inbox shows delivery ticks turning to read and customers typing back, campaigns are built in a three-step wizard with a live phone preview and a sending animation, and templates, automations, contacts and reports fill out the rest. The sample data is a fabric shop in Lahore, priced in rupees.
how: Open the inbox, filter by channel, unread or your chats, and reply; watch the ticks go from sent to delivered to read.
Insert an approved template into a reply, assign the chat to a teammate, or close and reopen it.
Start a new campaign: pick a channel and audience, write the message while the phone preview updates, then send or schedule it.
Watch the sending animation fill the audience dots, then open the campaign to see its funnel.
Add, edit, import and tag contacts; each one shows which channels they agreed to.
Turn automations on or off and type a test message to see which one would answer.
Write templates (WhatsApp ones wait for approval), top up message credit and set quiet hours in Settings.
